# SSH identification fixtures

Synthetic reserved/local data shaped by RFC 4253 sections 4.2 and 5.1;
no real target, credentials, host keys or captured private data.
JSON escapes preserve exact CRLF bytes independently of Git newline conversion. openssh/dropbear demonstrate explicit software hints;
hostile embeds instruction-like text as untrusted evidence; legacy preserves an
unsupported protocol as partial identification-only metadata. No fixture is a
complete SSH connection or negotiated/authenticated session.
